description: Method Resolution Order: `Cls.__mro__`, the linear list of classes Python searches for attributes.
The algorithm that builds the MRO: subclasses before bases, base order preserved, each class once; it fails with `TypeError` when that is impossible.
A proxy for the next class after the current one in the MRO of the instance's type, not necessarily the written base.
Every method in the chain calls `super()` with a shared signature, so each class runs once whatever the composition.
A small class that adds one behavior and is combined with others through multiple inheritance.
